verses.en: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e manatua le mea ua oo ia te i matou; ina e silasila mai ia, ma ia e silafia le faalumaina o i matou.

verses.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.sm: Ua avea lo matou tofi mo tagata ese, ma o matou fale mo nuu ese.

verses.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
verses.sm: Ua mātuaoti i matou, ua leai ni tama; o matou tinā ua pei o fafine ua oti a latou tane.

verses.en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.sm: Ua matou feinu i vai ua faatauina i tupe; o la matou fafie ua aumaia i le faatau.

verses.en: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
verses.sm: Ua faasauaina i matou i le amo i o matou ua; ua lailoa i matou, ua leai sina mapu ia te i matou.

verses.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.sm: Ua matou tuuina atu le lima ia Aikupito ma Asuria, ina ia maoona ai i mea'e “ai.

verses.en: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.sm: Ua agasala o matou tamā, ua leai foi i latou; a o i matou, ua tauave e i matou a latou sala.

verses.en: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
verses.sm: Ua pule auauna ia te i matou; ua leai se tasi e laveai ia te i matou ai o latou lima.

verses.en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.sm: O le toa'i ua matou maua ai la matou mea e “ai, ona o le pelu ua i le vao.

verses.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.sm: Ua mu o matou pau e peiseai se ogaumu, ona ua velavela o le oge.

verses.en: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.sm: Ua latou fetoso fafine i Siona, o taupou foi i aai o luta.

verses.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.sm: Na faatautauina alii i o latou lima; sa le ava i toeaina.

verses.en: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.sm: Na latou aveina atu taulelea e olo i maaolo; na taupaù foi tama i avegafafie.

verses.en: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.sm: Ua tuua e toeaina O le faitotoa, o taulelea foi ua tuu a latou pese.

verses.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.sm: Ua mavae le fiafia o matou loto; ua liua la matou siva ma faanoanoa.

verses.en: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.sm: Ua paù le palealii i lo matou ulu; oi talofa ia te i matou nei, aua ua agasala i matou.

verses.en: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua vaivai ai o matou loto; o mea ia ua faapouliuligia ai o matou mata;

verses.en: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.sm: aua o le mauga o Siona ua tuufua, ua feoai ai alope.

verses.en: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.sm: O oe, le ALII e, e tumau oe e faavavau; o lou nofoalii e auga tupulaga lea.

verses.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
verses.sm: Po o le a ea le mea e te faagalogaloina ai o i matou e faavavau? e te tuua ea O i matou i aso e tele?

verses.en: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e faaliliuina o i matou ia te oe, ona faaliliuina ai lea o i matou; ia e faafouina o matou aso e pei o anamua.

verses.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
verses.sm: Aua ua e matuā lafoai ia te i matou; ua toasa tele lava oe ia te i matou.
